searchText: Micah, you wanna have a call where we can talk through this? I'm in SE Asia, which makes scheduling such a thing quite difficult, which is why I tend to stick to chat. (I really should be sleeping right now) If you are around/available in like 8-10 hours perhaps? Get some sleep. I'll write something up and when you're up tomorrow you can let me know what questions you still have
